reflections.summary: Fix temporal chaining (anchor one main event, chain others with :overlap, no parent for copular -91 predicates, relative time words depend on DCT); Chinese classifiers as :unit; adverbs as :mod nodes; Chinese name brackets, no wiki, :place/:medium; aspect cues (habitual institutional activity, 已经+stop = state, 被称为 = performance); :reason for 因为/由于/以…而; 不过/可是 → but-91; distribute modifiers over conjuncts; no invented args; prefer PropBank verb over belong-91; have-degree-91 superlatives; split coordinated noun pairs. Add Examples section.

Fix the 目前 temporal rule and its wrong example; add copular-root anchoring and governing-event rules; restrain coreference; narrow the 已经+end-verb state cue; add role rules (:part-of for editions, ARG0 for intransitive -00 verbs, no borrowed subjects, identity-91 for event-noun heads); keep compound verbs whole, 历史上 as :temporal, no aspect on have-degree-91; modal triple for root abstract predicate; update examples.

Fix 曾经 temporal handling and stative aspect with 过; no :polarity on 未经 and no performance for negated events; 停刊-01 not -00; :part-of only with an expressed whole; :aspect state on root abstract predicates; :depends-on for naming clauses; partial-affirmative for usual-procedure nominals under negation; update examples.

Fix date anchoring (DCT :before date, date :overlap event), reason/purpose temporal order, cross-sentence anchoring; add have-reason-91/have-purpose-91 for paired clause connectives; apposition with identity-91, 由X改为Y roles, part-of objects, role nouns, 量 measure nouns with have-quant-91, middle dot in names, :era for 年代, 该刊; stronger no-invented-arguments rule; Chinese PropBank role numbering for 成/达到/跌; :manner + habitual for 印刷; realized purpose full-affirmative; no coref across different verbs; sentence-initial 不过 not annotated; examples.

Fix 由X改为Y with a topic subject (:part-of on X, no :ARG0) and the full-build-at-first-mention re-entrancy rule; V+量 inner verb gets no aspect/modal; purpose events are activity, habitual cue narrowed (relative clause of founded thing = process); named humans are individual-person in Chinese; update examples and checklist.

Resolve the contradictory re-entrancy rule: build a repeated entity in full at its first mention in the sentence's word order, even when that branch is written later in PENMAN (e.g. under have-reason-91 :ARG2); annotate the 改为 example accordingly.

Add rules for reported-content temporal/modal/:quote, contrast overlap, summary sentences anchored to DCT, 虽然…不过 but-91, 以X为目的, parenthetical slogans, consecutive for 后来, control-verb re-entrancy exception, connectives without modal, 有/如…等 :example lists, :frequency, 有-03 relationships, 指-02/算是-01, title-before-name, planet, 母公司 split, 前 :mod, aspect of nominal under 停止 and 生存; trim redundant examples and preamble to fit.

Freed space (shorter preamble/abridgement note, removed checklist and redundant examples), then fixed: org/publication pronouns reuse the entity variable and corefer to the named entity; 算是-01 roles, implicit-argument for 其中最, 可 = neutral-affirmative, summary sentences DCT :before, event nominal senses, no subset-of from 其中; role-noun + org name apposition, shortened name repeat as own node with in-sentence same-entity, shared sentence-initial date; conceiver triples on the :quote top node, 被指 conceiver = whole subject, slogan identity-91 state + :quote, 宣称 performance; list characters as individual-person with full name; narrower adverb nodes; 出现 :ARG1. Added examples.

Fix reported-content modal triples (only :quote nodes get author+speaker; nested events author only; 被指/据说 content events conceiver only), add slogan-verb :ARG0 re-entrancy exception, add explicit alignment cases for short repeats/母公司/外星人, update examples; free space by trimming preamble and redundant text.

Free space (drop sample graph, preamble, long type list, redundant examples); add rules for 「」 titles as publication names, named events with year, Chinese CPB adjectives as stative -01 verbs, general CPB roleset lookup (刊登/贴到 roles), fewer adverb nodes and 靠 as :reason, narrowed habitual cue, 为了-initial have-reason-91, nominal modifiers as :mod process, temporal chaining for coordinated/connective clauses and earlier reported content, publication as conceiver of its reporting acts, :part-of for content/articles; add short examples.

Narrow the 「」 publication rule (reporting-verb object = reported clause with :quote on every event); fix temporal rules (no parent for named-event/date time phrases in reports, 时-clause is child, and-conjunct chaining, 靠 = overlap, but-91 anchoring); rewrite reported-speech modal rule to match gold (speaker conceives its reporting events, content events author only); identity-91 equating noun with title/content gets aspect state + modal; verbal modifiers (合成-01 :ARG1-of, 握手-01 :mod process, 复制人, 全世界), 有-06, -00 when CPB sense does not fit; have-example-91 for 如; trimmed overview, :mode line, type list and redundant examples for space.

报导「…」 :quote on the report node itself; 支持 X V CPB roles and no aspect/modal on nested complement; control exception extended to 有能力 V and 为了 clauses; clause-initial 为了 → have-reason-91 without aspect/modal, purpose performance, 也 kept; re-entrancy only for specific referents; have-example-91 bare; V+N kind vs specific aspect/temporal; 墙上 kept; adjective conjuncts hang from governing event; trimmed old examples.
